extracted.name: Healthier Creamy Yogurt Salad Dressings
extracted.description: Recipe video above. Here's 5 very, very good creamy dressings made with yogurt instead of mayonnaise. All the flavour of their traditional mayo-based counterparts, but less fat and better for you! You might ditch that jar of mayo for good!
ingredient_lines: 1/4 tsp EACH dried dill, parsley, chives, garlic powder, black pepper
1/2 tsp EACH onion powder, mustard powder
1/4 tsp EACH garlic powder, salt and pepper
2 anchovy fillets or 3/4 tsp Anchovy paste ((Note 2))
instruction_lines: Mix ingredients in a bowl. Set aside for 30 minutes+ to allow flavours to develop.
Use milk to adjust to desired consistency.
Blitz in a food processor until smooth. Use milk to adjust consistency.
